scope: O01 pure existing-person strict protocol and Native local module/fold tests only; root owns registry/driver/approval/SDK/real Loader composition. No existing file/checklist edits by this agent.

verification.command: TMPDIR="$PWD/.local/world-completion/tmp" pnpm exec tsc -b tsconfig.host.json --pretty false

contracts: Request/apply/mutation preserve exact organization, position, existing person and description; no Persona/binding/Session/Participant/requester injection accepted.

Person must be active, ready, cognition=agent, kind=person, bound to the confirmed canonical Team and have its original confirmed private candidate/director Channel. No repair, cloning or new Channel is performed.

Explicit live eligible-for-hire relation must have subject=person, object=organization and scope=organization; actual requester needs its current scoped can-hire operation grant and active canonical identity.
All current/future candidate assignments across every scope block employment; completed relation history remains untouched.
Open-ended target assignment checks peak simultaneous current/future occupancy plus every unconfirmed/cancel-requested generated-hire reservation.

Read-set covers candidate revision/binding fingerprint, eligibility/grants, candidate subject-assignment set and target assignments/reservations composite fingerprint; unrelated global revisions do not stale.
Commit is synchronous and revalidates all requirements plus current per-case approval; any globally unconfirmed generated-hire structural obligation blocks commit while preserving the request/plan.
Native fold creates only one deterministic assignment and result/mutation. All existing Entity/profile/cognition/binding objects are preserved.

Onboarding derives actual existing actor and original confirmed candidate/director Channel from original mutation/plan/result/binding-hash/assignment; it does not retry eligibility or new-grant checks after employment.
limits: Root owns actual generic first-action wake atomic wiring and real Loader create/cold-restore composition evidence.
No offer/interview workflow, noncognitive upgrade, cross-employer forced hiring, monetary effect or identity/Channel preparation is supported.
